title: The Hippodrome — every model that answers on the house network, carded
how: runtime/arena.pi --card, run on eastGate. Speeds are tokens per second as Ollama reports them, measured while the body's own crons were also using the GPU. The five tasks are checked by rule: math and trace pass when the reply's first or last number is right; json when the object parses with both values; extract when all three unit names are there; oneword only when the reply is that one word, so it measures obedience as much as knowledge. A tissue answers through its own system prompt. Five tasks are a first sorting, not a verdict.
